title: God-class decomposition contract (L52)
description: Decomposition strategy for container + autonomy runtime. See ADR-061.

invariants.name: public_surface_preserved
must: no symbol rename on Container public surface
tests using Container API continue to pass without modification

invariants.name: cached_property_pin_honored
invariants.description: Per ADR-036 — each sub-module preserves @cached_property on the 39 service accessors.
must: L36 test_container_cached_property_pin updated to match new layout

invariants.name: l51_contract_gates
invariants.description: PR #284 fan-in contract test passes on every split PR.

invariants.name: no_transitive_depth_claim
invariants.description: ADR forbids cold-boot claim. Benefit is blast radius only.
must: docs do NOT claim cold-import reduction
PR descriptions do NOT cite cold-boot wins

invariants.name: lines_per_pr_max_200
invariants.description: Each PR moves <=200 lines from monolith.

invariants.name: composition_over_inheritance
invariants.description: Sub-modules attach via composition, not multiple inheritance.

out_of_scope: Further decomposition beyond 5+3 (operator decision based on how split holds up)
